description: Use when building or checking an invoice for a Romanian company and you only have its CUI, or to check a partner before invoicing: ANAF data already in e-Factura form: legal name, VAT id (RO… only for VAT payers), trade register number, address with county as ISO code (RO-CJ) and Bucharest city as SECTOR1..6, plus flags: inactive, VAT on collection, e-Factura registry. Free, 100 lookups per day per IP.
name: lookup_company
